hypothesis: Extending Seed 599 Arm B from 512 to 2048 Adam updates on the identical authenticated 2048-state dataset may convert its replay-coverage advantage into absolute playing strength against serving P-E4.

treatment.name: B2048
treatment.schedule_definition: Python random.Random(599), independently shuffle membership indexes per pass, batch in groups of 32; first 512 batches must equal the published Seed 599 B schedule exactly
treatment.start_state: Reload P-E4 parent checkpoint and create fresh Adam optimizer; do not continue from B512 checkpoint

reproducibility_stop: Before continuing to update 513, rerun from P-E4 with fresh optimizer through update 512 and compare every checkpoint tensor exactly with immutable Seed 599 B512. Stop on any mismatch.

evaluation.design: matched opening groups; seat-swapped games for each candidate; B512 and B2048 both play serving P-E4
evaluation.serving_value_evaluator: unchanged serving P-E4 for both candidate policies
evaluation.puct: identical to Seed 599 registered configuration: 128 simulations, c_puct=1.25, one worker per game, deterministic roots, exact-root enabled at 16, other settings unchanged

bootstrap.method: paired opening-cluster percentile bootstrap preserving seat outcomes

evaluation.primary_gate: B2048 versus P-E4 one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound strictly greater than 0.50
evaluation.secondary_gate: paired B2048 minus B512 two-sided 95% interval lower endpoint strictly greater than zero

interpretation.both_pass: Evidence of absolute strength above parity and a positive optimization benefit over B512.
interpretation.strength_only: B2048 clears the absolute-strength gate; added updates are not shown to improve on B512.
interpretation.benefit_only: B2048 improves on B512, but absolute strength above parity is not established.
interpretation.neither_pass: Neither absolute strength nor positive incremental benefit is established.

evaluation.selection: Seed 599 evaluation outcomes are excluded from confirmatory inference and checkpoint selection.

authorization.training: separate explicit owner authorization bound to the training execution freeze
authorization.evaluation: separate explicit owner authorization bound to the evaluation execution freeze
